faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the International Advanced Research Centre for Powder Metallurgy and New Materials (ARCI) for hiring qualified professionals on a contract basis in Hyderabad, Telangana.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised under ARCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Science Communicator & Designer under advertisement number ARCI/HRD/SCD/2/2026, aimed at individuals with expertise in communication, media studies, or relevant scientific and engineering disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this position?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Science Communicator & Designer post, offering a unique opportunity for eligible candidates to work in an advanced research environment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Science Communicator & Designer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master’s Degree in Communication, Journalism, Mass Communication, Media Studies, Science Communication, Public Relations, Advertising, Digital Media, Physical/Chemical/Materials Sciences, or a B.E./B.Tech./M.E./M.Tech. degree in Materials Science, Engineering, or Technology.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants applying for ARCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for applicants is not exceeding 40 years as on the closing date of the application. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories in accordance with Government of India guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary range offered for this contract position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary ranging from Rs. 50,000/- to Rs. 70,000/-, depending upon qualifications, relevant professional experience, demonstrated expertise, and overall suitability for the position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of applications via email is 03 November 2026. Candidates must ensure their complete application reaches the designated email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for ARCI Science Communicator & Designer Recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted through Email. Eligible candidates are required to send their detailed CV, Statement of Purpose, and portfolio or work samples to the designated official email address.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a provisional shortlisting of candidates based on the details provided in their detailed CV, followed by a personal discussion for the candidates who get shortlisted.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification details?
faq.answer: You can visit the official ARCI website at https://www.arci.res.in to view detailed guidelines, download the official notification PDF, and obtain further updates regarding the recruitment process.
